input.rationale: Section 4(c) is the only effects-of-termination provision: Kubient ceases the Services, the licence is revoked, Customer ceases use, and each Party returns or destroys the other's Confidential Information. There is no obligation to return or export AP's data (Requests, Content, visitor data held by Kubient) in a usable format, no deletion certification, and no transition or wind-down assistance. In a hosted ad-auction services arrangement that leaves us below even the fallback (90 days' transition assistance plus export within 30 days), and the generic \"return or destroy\" Confidential Information option risks destruction of our data on exit. Inserted the preferred exit provision (six months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable return, then deletion with written certification), with 90 days offered as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and data return/deletion obligations into termination section 4(c)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short exit provision: on termination Kubient provides up to six months of transition assistance at its then-current rates and returns our data (Requests, Content and visitor data) in a machine-readable format within 30 days, then deletes and certifies deletion. The current 4(c) only stops the Services and addresses Confidential Information, which leaves us without our data or migration support. We can accept 90 days of transition assistance if six months is not workable.

ops.text: (v) at Customer's request, Kubient will provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months following the effective date of termination or expiration, at Kubient's then-current rates; and

(vi) within thirty (30) days following termination or expiration, Kubient will return to Customer all Customer data in Kubient's possession or control, including without limitation Requests, Content and visitor information (data) collected, maintained or stored by Kubient, in a commonly used, machine-readable format, and will thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
